content.rationale: The table is where verbs' shared routing meets the substrate and the one-verb rule; the gate forces the routing claim to answer to both without demanding behavior. Its two edges span two cells — one prose parent (natural→natural) and one requirement-sentence parent (structured→natural) — so the criterion is the default cell's gate form; the mixed cell is flagged for the matrix (F1 follow-up).
